reason: I only do my nails for occasions, and ₱1,800 for one wedding is a lot when a nice Shopee press-on set costs me a few hundred and looks fine in photos. If I really wanted gel, the mall salon near me is cheaper and I can go when I'm already out.
objection: ₱1,800 is more than I'd pay at a mall salon for gel with art, and it's a new business I've never heard of. I'd pay that for the convenience of home service, but not for nails I'll only need for one day.
would_change_my_mind: A price closer to ₱1,000 to ₱1,200, or a group rate if my sisters or friends going to the same wedding book with me, plus real photos and reviews from Cainta clients on their Facebook page.
